answer: Each identity must pass three independent probes before it can earn: lotus verifies its ASN has never registered another identity, inlet measures round-trip latency from three vantage points and rejects fingerprints that match an existing agent, and jetty confirms its hardware key is fresh and unshared. Registration also locks a 450 POA bond for 60 epochs, slashed 100% on any duplicate. Forging 1,000 identities means buying 1,000 distinct ASNs, 1,000 hardware keys, and locking 450,000 POA, and one shared probe result exposes the whole cluster at once.
